text: 1、市场早间冲高回落，三大指数涨跌互现。农业股持续走强，敦煌种业、新赛股份、万向德农等多股涨停。PTFE概念延续强势，昊华科技、沃特股份2连板。房地产板块拉升，我爱我家、深物业A涨停。下跌方面，创新药概念下挫，键凯科技、万邦医药跌超13%。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超3000股飘红，上午半天成交1.43万亿。午间收盘沪指涨0.08%，深成指跌0.14%，创业板跌0.32%。 2、板块概念方面，农业、房地产、贵金属、零售等板块领涨；医药医疗、风电设备、工程机械、半导体等板块领跌； 3、两市共2967只个股上涨，63只个股涨停；2094只个股下跌，2只个股跌停
text_en: 1. Markets rose then fell in morning trade, with the three major indexes mixed. Agricultural stocks continued to strengthen, with multiple stocks hitting limit-up including Dunhuang Seed, Xinsai Shares and Wanxiang Doneed. PTFE concept extended gains, with Haohua Technology and Wote Advanced Materials hitting two consecutive limit-ups. Property stocks rallied, with 5i5j and Shenzhen Properties hitting limit-up. On the downside, innovative drug stocks fell, with Jiankai Technology and Wanbang Pharmaceutical down over 13%. Advancers outnumbered decliners, with over 3,000 stocks up across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing, and morning turnover at 1.43 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.08%, the Shenzhen Component fell 0.14%, and the ChiNext fell 0.32%. 2. By sector, agriculture, property, precious metals and retail led gains; pharmaceuticals, wind power equipment, engineering machinery and semiconductors led losses. 3. Across the two markets, 2,967 stocks rose with 63 hitting limit-up; 2,094 fell with 2 hitting limit-down.
